string.name: name
string.value: Maple Leaf Blessing Buff

string.name: desc
string.value: A special buff given by the Maple Leaf, symbol of Maple World. Increases ATT and Magic ATT for 30 minutes. Can be stacked with other buffs.

string.name: h1
string.value: The buff's effects will vary depending on the achievements you got in the D-Day event. Explorers can receive even stronger buff effects.

string.name: name
string.value: Danger Dodge

string.name: desc
string.value: A rapid teleport to rescue the lamb from peril.

string.name: h
string.value: Teleports the lamb out of harm's way. Can be used once per second.
